story.hoboRuckus: “Hey, dude! Fancy a sandwich?” I waved it under his nose. “It’s yours, but first I need a favour: go in there and make a scene. A big one.” He looked at the sandwich, then at me, then at the sandwich again. He took it, swallowed half of it in one bite, and marched into the pizzeria. A minute later he was standing on a table, shouting about loopholes and the end of time at the top of his lungs.
